import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV
weather = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

# Prepare temperatures for each city
cities = weather['city'].dropna().unique()
data = [weather.loc[weather['city'] == city, 'temp_c'].dropna() for city in cities]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
ax.boxplot(data, tick_labels=cities)

plt.show()
